New operator command `minds-admin repair-home-layout` for slice workspaces the imbue_cloud slow path rebuilt on the legacy volume layout. On such a workspace only the mngr host_dir is on the persistent volume; `/home/user` (the workspace checkout, the user's apps and skills, dotfiles) lives in the container's writable layer, where host_backup cannot find it and fails every tick. The command takes one or more `--host-id` values. By default it only probes each workspace and reports its layout. With `--migrate` it stops the workspace's chats and services for a few minutes, snapshots the volume for rollback, copies the home tree onto the volume as `home/`, moves the host_dir under it, and symlinks `/home/user` onto the volume, which is the layout a bake produces, then restarts the services and waits for the system interface and host-backup to come back. The in-VM script ignores SIGHUP and SIGPIPE, so a migration runs to its own completion and restarts the services it stopped even if the operator's SSH session drops partway through. `--rollback` reverses a migration while its aside copy and snapshot still exist. Results are a JSON report, one outcome per workspace.
